shifters.name: Vance Holloway, the Cinder Marshal
shifters.era: A burnt-out frontier lawman from a parallel Wild West where the sun never set — the first, weakest shifter the squad meets, a dust-caked marshal who chased a fugitive THROUGH a tear in his own dimension and now rifts after any drifter he reads as an outlaw.
shifters.behavior: PHASE-IN INCURSION (early-tier, the introductory shifter): rifts in at the arena edge with a short rust-orange implosion telegraph, then BLINKS in three quick revolver-range hops toward the nearest drifter, closing to gun distance rather than into melee — he KITES at his preferred range and snaps off heavy single slugs (the Revolver Cannon's slow, decisive shots, each parryable). After hunting for the incursion window he detonates a final muzzle-flash and PHASES OUT in a rust burst, recurring more often and at higher HP as the dimension chain deepens. Modeled on the spitter/kite framework: ranged single-slug fire, contactDamage 0 (all threat is the aimed shot, like the duelist deals no passive touch). renderScale ~1.2.
shifters.artPrompt: Vance Holloway, the Cinder Marshal — a DIMENSION SHIFTER roaming-invader enemy, limbless construction, FULL build (body + 2 detached blob hands + 2 detached blob feet), generated EMPTY-HANDED, drawn for green-gap part-slicing. A HUMANOID pill-grunt: one rounded charcoal-and-rust capsule torso wearing a long sun-scorched tin-star duster that hugs the body and ends in a clean ragged hem (NO cape, NO billowing fabric), a battered low-crowned marshal hat fused to a SIMPLE chrome-pin sheriff star at the collar. FACELESS head: under the hat brim a dark void with ONE small glowing ember-orange dot-eye — no mouth, nose, or human features. TWO detached oval mitten hand-blobs (NO fingers), one floating clear of each side; TWO detached scuffed-boot foot-blobs below — EVERY detached part sits fully OUTSIDE the body silhouette with a clear flat-#00ff00 gap around it, never fused or overlapping. Stands UPRIGHT and PLANTED on both feet, side-profile FACING RIGHT, neutral standing stance (NOT dynamic/lunging). Palette pulled from charcoal #22252B, gunmetal #3A4049, rust #A8482E, tan #C49A5A, bone #CFC6AE with one ember-orange #FF8A2B accent dot-eye; ~5-6 colours. ONE uniform heavy slightly-uneven black outline, flat cel shading only (base + 1 shadow + at most 1 highlight per region), ZERO VFX/glow/bloom/sparks baked into the sprite — the lit eye is a small solid bright shape, not radiating. Behemoth-chunky readable silhouette rendered grim and gritty like Darkest Dungeon. Render on a perfectly flat fully-opaque #00ff00 chroma field, no ground/floor/shadow/background. Original, trademark-distinct design.

shifters.name: Kaori Tsuge, the Voltaic Ronin
shifters.era: A masterless storm-blade duelist from a neon-drowned far-future shogunate, exiled across the dimensions for cutting down her own warlord — the mid-tier shifter, faster and deadlier than the Marshal, who phases in hunting any squad whose arsenal hums with the same current as her blade.
shifters.behavior: PHASE-IN INCURSION (mid-tier, the duelist shifter): rifts in with a cyber-cyan implosion crack, then BLINK-teleports two or three lightning-short hops to a locked melee distance (the spatial parry tell), telegraphs a white windup, and strings a fast 3-hit advancing combo — each strike LUNGES forward and the arc-hit seeds her blade's chain-lightning to nearby drifters. Deals NO passive contact damage (all threat is the parryable combo, like Ronin). After the combo's recover she BLINKS to re-approach, hunts for the incursion window, then phases OUT in a cyan flash. Recurs faster + tankier deeper into the chain. Built on the duelist melee state machine (approach/windup/hits/swingGap/recover/step). renderScale ~1.22.

shifters.name: Brother Mordecai, the Grave Warden
shifters.era: A plague-era gravedigger-monk from a drowned cathedral-city in a sunken medieval dimension, who dug too deep and tore through to the spaces between worlds — the heaviest, late-tier shifter, a slow tombstone-swinging executioner who phases in late and hits like a wall.
shifters.behavior: PHASE-IN INCURSION (late-tier, the heavy bruiser shifter — the most dangerous of the three): rifts in with a slow dull-teal grave-light implosion, then BLINKS in a few heavy ground-shuddering hops toward the squad, closing to melee. He swings the colossal Reaper's Lid coffin-greatsword in slow, telegraphed, hard-hitting arcs (a 2-hit heavy combo, each strike a parryable white-tell haymaker that advances a short lunge); deals NO passive contact damage — the slab IS the threat (like the duelist). Tankiest + slowest of the three, killable but only just inside the incursion window before he phases OUT in a teal grave-burst; recurs deeper into the chain at escalating HP. Built on the duelist melee state machine with a slow, heavy 2-hit cadence. renderScale ~1.35.
